summary.zh: 结合向量与关键词检索提升召回
summary.en: Combine vector and keyword search to improve recall

description.zh: 将语义检索与关键词检索组合，并说明分数融合与结果合并的处理方式。适合单一检索方式召回不足、需要兼顾精确匹配与语义相近的场景。需要同时具备向量索引和全文索引。
description.en: Combines vector and keyword retrieval and covers score fusion and result merging. Suits cases where one method alone misses results and both exact and semantic matches matter. Needs a vector index and a full-text index.
